[{"type":"text","text":"Small Fan Brush is a versatile and essential tool in makeup application, known for its unique fan-shaped bristles. Here are some key features and uses:

Description:

Shape and Size: The brush head is spread out in a thin, fan-like shape, with a small and compact size that allows for precision and control.
Bristles: The bristles are typically soft and made from horse hair, providing a gentle touch on the skin.
Handle: The handle is usually short and ergonomic, designed for easy maneuverability and precise application.
Uses:

Highlighting: The Small Fan Brush is perfect for applying highlighter to the cheekbones, brow bone, and down the bridge of the nose, creating a subtle and natural glow.
Contouring: It can be used to apply contour powder with precision, especially in smaller areas like the sides of the nose or under the lips.
Blending: The soft bristles are excellent for blending out harsh lines, ensuring a seamless and natural finish.
Detail Work: Ideal for applying powder to small, targeted areas without overloading product, such as setting concealer under the eyes or applying a touch of shimmer to the inner corners of the eyes.
Clean-Up: The fan shape makes it useful for dusting away excess powder, fallout from eyeshadow, or gently sweeping away any mistakes without disturbing the rest of your makeup.
Benefits:

Precision: Its small size allows for detailed and controlled application.
Versatility: Can be used for multiple purposes, from highlighting to blending and more.
Ease of Use: The shape and design make it easy to handle, even for makeup beginners.
A Small Fan Brush is a handy addition to any makeup kit, offering both functionality and precision for a flawless makeup look.

[{"type":"text","text":"Description:

Elevate your makeup experience with our expertly crafted brush set, packaged in a makeup brush cylinder for easy storage and travel.
Each brush is designed with your beauty needs in mind, and the set offers a complete toolkit to help you create stunning makeup looks with confidence and precision.
Set includes:

Face Brush: Versatile brush for applying powder, bronzer, or setting powder to lock in your makeup.
Flat Brush: Applicator for skincare and liquid foundation
Foundation Brush: A flat-top, dense brush ideal for applying liquid or cream foundation. It provides full coverage with a streak-free finish, ensuring a smooth, even complexion.
Concealer Brush: Designed for precise application of concealer to hard-to-reach areas. The small, rounded tip ensures that product is applied smoothly and evenly.
Angled Blusher & Contouring Brush: Sculpt your features with precision using the angled design for blush and contouring.
Crease Blending Brush: Create depth and dimension by blending colours seamlessly into the crease.
